title: Quality of Livia
description: Minimal client-side adjustments to match the modified server of Livia SMP
body:
# Quality of Livia

Livia Client is a client-side QoL Fabric mod for [Livia SMP](https://modrinth.com/server/livia-smp).

## Features

- **Anvil sync** — suppresses client-side cost prediction so the anvil UI always reflects the server's actual result
- **Livia enchantment descriptions** — adds tooltip descriptions for Livia's custom enchantments when Enchantment Descriptions mod is installed
- **Tree Stripper enchantment sync** — keeps axe stripping prediction aligned with Livia's server-side enchantment behavior
- **Villager trading** — mirrors Livia's no-discount trade pricing in the client UI
- **Pickup filter** — keybind toggle that asks the server to filter pickups using the current inventory
- **Crawling** — optional crouch/look gesture for crawling through tight spaces, with configurable sensitivity
- **Hotbar cycling** — configurable keybinds for cycling the selected hotbar slot
- **Disable offhand use** — optional toggle that prevents offhand item use

## Configuration

Quality of Livia uses a Mod Menu settings screen. Mod Menu is optional, but installing it exposes toggles, sensitivity, and keybind settings.

## Optional Addons

- **EnchantmentDescriptions** — if installed, Livia's custom enchantments show the descriptions bundled by this mod. Quality of Livia does not require it.

Server-backed features only activate when connected to Livia SMP.
